summary: Library urges FCC to reject proposals to terminate E-Rate, emphasizing its critical role in maintaining affordable, reliable internet access for patrons and staff.

claims.argument: Terminating E-Rate would represent a cut to public library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading networks.
claims.evidence_quote: Terminating that support represents a cut to public library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading those networks.
